hypothesis: FCLR-H003: funding + price features improve out-of-sample forecasts of next-24h realized-variance STRESS / tail-exceedance (train-only 95th percentile) beyond an RV-only HAR baseline.
target: next-24h realized variance > train-only 95th percentile (binary stress event)
threshold: train-only 95th percentile of train next-24h RV; never recomputed on test
splits: 60/20/20 by unique UTC timestamp; 7-day (168h) purge/embargo at train/val and val/test boundaries; test -> 3 interleaved blocks

models.C2: B1 + signed funding(24h) + trailing 90d |funding| percentile + mark/index premium + mark/EMA24 distance

primary_contrast: C2 vs B1 on paired test-set Brier score
inference: >=2000 deterministic moving-block bootstrap replicates (block=24 rows, seed=20261126); report Brier/log-loss/ECE, 95% CI, per-block, leave-one-symbol-out
decision_rule: PROMOTED iff relative Brier reduction >=2% AND bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND test data sufficient; else NOT_SUPPORTED; INCONCLUSIVE if test data insufficient
